addressed_edge_text_repetition.most_frequent_normalised_edge_text: open a new pull request to apply changes based on [this feedback](

combined_flag_rule: an account is flagged when it trips at least 2 of the four pre-registered heuristics
interpretation: 1 of 80 user accounts that write an exact addressed edge trip at least 2 machine-likeness heuristics, covering 1 of 105 user-written edge events; dropping every PR whose edge such an account wrote moves the adjusted later-merge contrast from 0.1735 [0.0726, 0.2744] to 0.1792 [0.0783, 0.2801]; 102 of 105 addressed-edge texts are distinct after normalisation, and manual reading of the highest-scoring accounts finds that the repetition driving the template heuristic is hand-issued agent invocations and GitHub UI button text rather than generated output, so the audit supports the claim that a person writes the reply while showing that what the person writes is often a one-line trigger rather than a substantive engineering response
scope: sensitivity audit of the actor classification behind the addressed edge; heuristics are behavioural proxies, not ground truth about account operation
